title: The Part Library page has no button that creates an entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a part, part A, at the test location, so the Part Library lists its entry.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the checkbox of the part A row.
  3. Click the three-dot icon (⋮) at the left end of the table's header row.
  4. Press Escape.
  5. Click the part A row, away from its checkbox.
  6. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  7. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.
  • The title row reads "Part Library", with Search, "Manufacturer: All manufacturers" and "Category: All categories" to its right.
  • No button or link on the page creates an entry: there is no "New Catalog Part", "New Library Part", "New", "Add" or "+" control.

Step 2:

  • The part A row is ticked.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers actions for the ticked rows, such as Set category, and nothing that creates an entry.

Step 4:

  • The menu closes.

Step 5:

  • The entry's detail page opens, with a Part details panel on the left and a Parts table on the right: no window for creating an entry opens.

Step 6:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens, holding part A's part number: it edits this entry.

Step 7:

  • The window closes and the entry is unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S11-R1: “The Part Library page has no control that creates a Part Library entry.”
  • S11-R2: “No dialog for creating a Part Library entry can be reached from the Part Library page.”
  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
  • Key Decisions: “The Part Library has no standalone create. Every Part Library entry is created from a part number in use. In the reference dataset 19,664 of 29,376 entries had no inventory part behind them and 17,359 were referenced by nothing at all.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
